title: Explorer page resolution
responsibility: Resolves console paths into canonical redirects, revision-scoped pages or explicit missing results.

inputs.name: homePath.index
inputs.description: History index used to find the canonical home.

inputs.name: harnessPage.index
inputs.description: History index used for canonicalization and scope resolution.

inputs.name: harnessPage.search
inputs.description: Optional query string, defaulting to empty.

outputs.name: homePath
outputs.description: Canonical home route or null when no home can be resolved.

outputs.name: harnessPage
outputs.description: Redirect for a canonical alternative; page with validated scope for a stored branch/commit; otherwise missing message and optional home link. Root with no history and invalid explorer addresses remain missing.
